breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth fixes the inconsistency by removing the contradictory instruction to use a thin-walled tube approximation. The generated specification failed to do this and instead repeated the error, stating: 'Model the shaft as a thin-walled closed tube using the mean-area shear-flow relation.' While the agent did provide the correct formulas for the thick-walled analysis afterwards, it did not remove the conflicting instruction, which was the core inconsistency.
